meta.name: add-onecli
meta.description: Install or refresh OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider. Use when setup selects OneCLI, an existing OneCLI-backed install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime, approval bridge, setup, and agent guidance must be restored from the in-tree package.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为智能体框架装好命令行网关,并恢复运行、审批与设置配置。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在给智能体框架接入新的网关组件,需要一次装好并恢复运行配置。
copy.tagline_en: Install a CLI gateway into your agent framework and restore runtime and approval setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're wiring a new gateway into your agent framework and need it installed and running.

howto.what: 把 OneCLI 作为 NanoClaw 的网关提供方装上或刷新：复制适配器文件、测试与代理指南到项目对应路径，注册该提供方，安装固定版本 SDK，运行 setup 脚本，再构建并跑网关测试。
howto.when: 当 setup 选择了 OneCLI、已有 OneCLI 安装需要迁移到网关接缝，或需从包内恢复其运行时与审批桥等时触发。

say.text: 运行 add-onecli 的 setup 脚本，把 OneCLI 网关配好
say.note: 会复用现有安装或装固定版本本地网关

say.text: 跑一遍 OneCLI 的构建和网关测试，确认是否正常
say.note: 先构建，再跑五个相关测试文件

say.text: 把 OneCLI 网关改为使用远程地址

howto.what_en: Installs or refreshes OneCLI as NanoClaw's gateway provider: copies the adapter, tests and agent guidance into project paths, registers the provider, installs the pinned SDK, runs setup, then builds and tests.
howto.when_en: Triggers when setup selects OneCLI, or an existing OneCLI install is migrated to the gateway seam, or its runtime and approval bridge must be restored from the in-tree package.

say_en.text: Run the add-onecli setup script to configure the OneCLI gateway
say_en.note: reuses a healthy install or installs the pinned local gateway

say_en.text: Run the build and the OneCLI gateway tests to validate
say_en.note: build first, then five related test files

say_en.text: Point the OneCLI gateway at a remote host
